title: Early detection of feline chronic kidney disease via 3-hydroxykynurenine and machine learning.
summary: The primary author manuscript reports 3-hydroxykynurenine as a feline CKD biomarker evaluated with ML; the result is a veterinary diagnostic association and does not establish prospective clinical utility.
